title: json5: add a trailingComma option to stringify
prompt: This is a copy of json5 2.2.3 (lib/). `JSON5.stringify` currently always writes a trailing comma after the last member when it pretty-prints (space is set). Add a `trailingComma` option, accepted in the options-object form of the second argument next to `space`, `quote` and `replacer`: `trailingComma: false` omits the comma after the last property or element at every nesting level; `true` or leaving it out keeps today's output. Compact output (no space) is never affected, and the existing `(value, replacer, space)` signature must keep working.
